blockers: Two fail-open validation defects require a repair slice.

evidence.outcome: Failed separately with EPERM writing node_modules/.vite-temp; source checks were not implicated.
A present but malformed or unsupported default_value can silently fall back to false/0/empty instead of being rejected; this violates required typed default validation.
Read/Validate do not require value wrapper keys or a non-null value. An artifact value such as {"type":"bool"} can deserialize with Value=null and pass validation, violating strict value validation.

next_slice.summary: Fix fail-closed default_value parsing and require exact required keys/non-null typed values, then rerun the full QA suite.

result: Automated builds/tests pass, but source inspection found fail-open validation defects.
